opening.argument: The speaker invites viewers to obtain OneCoin through mining, describing the coins as free and presenting trading, holding, selling, or transferring them through a future exchange as ways to participate. Those options frame OneCoin as a token opportunity tied to exchange access, not neutral cryptocurrency analysis. The description reinforces that invitation with a direct call to sign up for the webinar. The speaker also calls the offering “something very very special,” adding affirmative promotion to the practical directions for acquiring and using the coins. Together, these statements show an active funnel into a promised token-purchase and appreciation opportunity, while the claims of free coins and future exchange access risk misleading viewers about what participation offers.
